episodes.title: Part 1
episodes.summary: Convicted murderer Grace Marks claims she has no memory of the events surrounding the murder.

episodes.title: Part 2
episodes.summary: In 1859, Simon investigates the murders; in 1842, Grace befriends a woman who dies from a back-alley abortion.

episodes.title: Part 3
episodes.summary: In 1859 Simon attempts to extract Grace's repressed memories of the murders. In 1842 Grace begins work as a servant at the Kinnear farmhouse.

episodes.title: Part 4
episodes.summary: In 1859 Simon becomes intimate with Mrs. Humphrey, while in 1843 Jamie confesses his love for Grace.

episodes.title: Part 5
episodes.summary: In 1859, Grace tries neuro-hypnosis in an attempt to recover memories.

episodes.title: Part 6
episodes.summary: In 1859, Simon joins the Union Army; Grace gets some unexpected news in 1872.
